segments.sn35.164:1.3: “Yo kho, koṭṭhika, anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.164:1.5: Cakkhu kho, koṭṭhika, anattā; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.164:1.6: Rūpā anattā; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.164:1.7: Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.164:1.8: Cakkhusamphasso anattā; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.164:1.9: Yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā; tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … jivhā anattā;
segments.sn35.164:1.10: tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … mano anattā;
segments.sn35.164:1.12: Dhammā anattā; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.164:1.13: Manoviññāṇaṃ … manosamphasso … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā;
segments.sn35.164:1.16: Yo kho, koṭṭhika, anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo”ti.
